# artifactkit

> A UI kit for AI agents that write HTML. Produces one self-contained `.html`
> file — reports, dashboards, kanbans, wikis, scorecards, decks — that works
> offline from `file://`, prints properly, and carries no credentials.
> Zero dependencies in the core. MIT.

The core principle: **the written specification does more work than the CSS.**
Unconstrained LLM output agrees with itself on 58–67% of its styling vocabulary;
a specification lifts that to ~90%. So artifactkit is a vocabulary, a set of
content rules, and two validators, with CSS and JS as the delivery vehicle.

## For agents

- [SKILL.md](.agents/skills/artifactkit/SKILL.md): the agent skill. Gates, build
  procedure, content rules, component chooser, API, gotchas. Start here.
- [COMPONENTS](examples/swatch.html): every component rendered on one page.
- [RECIPES.md](.agents/skills/artifactkit/references/RECIPES.md): worked patterns
  per artifact type.
- [MODULES.md](.agents/skills/artifactkit/references/MODULES.md): optional
  libraries with licences, and what to avoid and why.

## Templates to copy

- [report.html](examples/templates/report.html): quarterly review, exhibits, KPI strip
- [dashboard.html](examples/templates/dashboard.html): filters, drilldown, deep link
- [tracker.html](examples/templates/tracker.html): kanban with save-to-file
- [deck.html](examples/templates/deck.html): slides with a presenter window
- [wiki.html](examples/templates/wiki.html): decision log with TOC and search
- [scorecard.html](examples/templates/scorecard.html): weighted scoring with a rubric
- [comparison.html](examples/templates/comparison.html): options matrix

## Hard constraints, measured not assumed

- `file://` **is** a secure context; File System Access and WebCrypto work
- all `file://` pages share **one** localStorage area, so keys must be namespaced
- ES modules are CORS-blocked; every script must be classic/UMD
- cross-origin `fetch` works only against APIs that send CORS headers
- OAuth from `file://` is impossible — fetch data at build time and inline it
- desktop Windows and macOS only; no mobile, no touch

## Commands

```
node scripts/build.mjs in.html -o out.html --id slug [--with marked] [--strip-notes]
node scripts/validate.mjs out.html    # self-containment, credentials, a11y
node scripts/drift.mjs out.html       # structural integrity
```
